items.title: File Einspruch against the prepayment assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter states the posting day (Aufgabe zur Post) as Saturday 21.11.2026 — this, not the earlier printed document date of 20.11.2026, is the authoritative start under § 122 Abs. 2 AO. Adding the statutory 4 days for mail posted since 2025 gives deemed delivery on Wednesday 25.11.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO the one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) starts the next day, 25.11.2026, and ends one month later on 25.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 25.12.2026 is Erster Weihnachtstag (a public holiday in NW and nationwide), and 26.12. is also a holiday, 27.12. is a Sunday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 28.12.2026.

items.title: Pay 1st-quarter 2027 income-tax prepayment
items.quote: setzen wir die Vorauszahlungen zur Einkommensteuer ab 2027 auf 1.120,00 € je Quartal fest, fällig jeweils am 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. und 10.12.
items.computation: The letter fixes a quarterly prepayment of €1,120.00 starting with calendar year 2027, due on the printed calendar dates 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. and 10.12. For the first instalment the relevant date is 10.03.2027, a Wednesday with no NW or nationwide public holiday that year, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO applies; the printed date stands.

items.title: Pay 2nd-quarter 2027 income-tax prepayment
items.quote: setzen wir die Vorauszahlungen zur Einkommensteuer ab 2027 auf 1.120,00 € je Quartal fest, fällig jeweils am 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. und 10.12.
items.computation: 10.06.2027 is a Thursday; checked against the 2027 NW holiday calendar (Christi Himmelfahrt falls on 06.05., Fronleichnam on 27.05., neither is 10.06.), so no shift applies and the printed date stands.

items.title: Pay 3rd-quarter 2027 income-tax prepayment
items.quote: setzen wir die Vorauszahlungen zur Einkommensteuer ab 2027 auf 1.120,00 € je Quartal fest, fällig jeweils am 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. und 10.12.
items.computation: 10.09.2027 is a Friday with no NW or nationwide public holiday on that date (Tag der Deutschen Einheit falls on 03.10., a Sunday that year, unrelated), so no shift applies and the printed date stands.

items.title: Pay 4th-quarter 2027 income-tax prepayment
items.quote: setzen wir die Vorauszahlungen zur Einkommensteuer ab 2027 auf 1.120,00 € je Quartal fest, fällig jeweils am 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. und 10.12.
items.computation: 10.12.2027 is a Friday with no public holiday nearby in the NW/nationwide calendar for that date, so no shift applies and the printed date stands.

warnings: The letter's own document date (Bescheid vom 20.11.2026, a Friday) is earlier than the separately stated posting date 'Aufgabe zur Post Samstag, 21.11.2026' — a Saturday posting by a tax office is unusual; if the actual envelope postmark differs from either date, the Einspruch deadline could move and should be checked against the envelope if kept.

The IBAN printed in the footer (DE39 4145 0075 0001 8002 00) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but this letter sets a payment obligation to come (prepayments), it does not request a payment to this account now — do not use this IBAN to pay anything unless a separate payment request confirms it.
